Quick update after reproducing locally with their payload: we see the 500 originates when a combined embeddings+reranker request hits the reranker stage after embedding generation. The root cause appears to be an out-of-memory condition in the reranker host when the request carries ~120 embedding vectors + additional metadata. Stack trace (trimmed):

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/reranker/service.py", line 218, in handle_request
    scores = reranker.score(batch_embeddings)
  File "/opt/rerank/lib/engine.py", line 93, in score
    attn = compute_attention(keys, values)
MemoryError: Unable to allocate 1.4GB for array of shape (120, 1024)

Mitigations we recommend for now:
- Split the flow: call embeddings in batches of <= 32, then call reranker on the smaller candidate set.
- Reduce batch size in the SDK or use streaming from the JS SDK to avoid building the full payload in-memory.
- Temporary routing: we can route Finlytics to a dedicated reranker instance with higher memory while we push a permanent fix.

I’ve opened INF-521 and attached the logs (finlytics-error-20260618.log) and a sample repro payload (repro-payload-20260618.json). Timeline: we can stand up a higher-memory reranker for a short maintenance window (2–4 hours) if Finlytics approves; permanent fix will be tracked in INF-521.

— Neha
